_comment: TOOL is public code and documentation.
FIXTURE is synthetic and generated by tools/make_fixtures.py.
DATA is real runtime output in a separate PRIVATE versioned companion, never in this public repository.
The pinned guards enforce classification; qq_storage.py resolves through guards/tools/datadir.py and requires live private visibility.
_audited: Pulls, recovery evidence, decoded output and output transaction files contain real runtime DATA. Every writing CLI verifies the separate PRIVATE companion before device access or writes; temporary files remain beside their private destination. A pull is explicitly an ownership-unverified candidate until key and account-field evidence passes. Decoder promotion is atomic. No raw or decoded archive can fall back into the public tool repository.
_fixture_note: No fixture file is committed. tools/make_fixtures.py builds a synthetic database into a temp directory at test time (see tools/test_qq.py), so there is no on-disk fixture that a real record could hide inside. The generator hardcodes only synthetic accounts and self-evidently fake text.
_data_home: QQ_HISTORY_EXPORT_DATA_DIR or QQ_HISTORY_EXPORT_CONFIG selects an existing PRIVATE versioned companion data directory. No public or unversioned output fallback.
